verdict.rationale: The Svelte team maintains a VS Code extension, other editors have integrations, and components can be written in TypeScript via lang="ts". That points to a first-party editor integration. However, the evidence never explicitly describes autocompletion or inline type-error reporting in the editor. `sv check` reports TypeScript errors only from the command line, and one community comment says IDE support has historically been an issue. missing for 10: explicit documentation of language-server autocompletion and inline type diagnostics, details of the editor integrations beyond VS Code, independent hands-on confirmation of accurate in-editor typing
